card.name: Supervision and guidance wording for users
card.fires_on: Words that point to who oversees or uses something: "supervision" after "guidance and", and "their", "your" or "with" before students or children. Also "prescribing" in prescriber instructions.

modes.label: Under supervision of a provider
modes.description: The word "supervision" in "use under the guidance and supervision of a healthcare provider" in injectable drug labels.
modes.example: Enbrel is intended for use under the guidance and<< supervision>> of a physician.

modes.description: A small word before students, kids or classroom in educational activity notes.

modes.label: Prescribing or storing advice
modes.description: A verb or noun in advice to prescribers or caregivers.
modes.example: Consider these risks when<< prescribing>> or dispensing OLINVYK.

card.writes: It seems to favor words about owning, supervising or overseeing, such as "own" and "supervise".
card.plain: It fires on wording about who oversees use, like a provider's supervision or a teacher's or parent's role with children.
